---
name: Skill request
about: Ask for a new Flutter or Dart skill
title: "Skill request: "
labels: skill request
---

**What task should the skill cover?**
One job, for example "migrate from Provider to Riverpod" or "set up Firebase Auth".

**What does the agent get wrong today?**
Describe a real mistake you saw an agent make on this task.

**Versions**
Flutter / Dart / package versions this applies to.

**Would you like to write it?**
- [ ] Yes, I can open a PR
- [ ] No, I only need it
